result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one major layout problem where content is cut off by the bottom navigation, and one minor loading-state issue on a restaurant image.

issues.description: The next restaurant card at the bottom is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the content look clipped and harder to access.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so cards clear the navigation bar, or make sure the bottom bar does not overlap the list.

issues.description: A loading spinner is visible on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, suggesting the image is still loading or not rendering cleanly.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearer skeleton/loading placeholder and ensure images load quickly or fail gracefully without leaving the spinner visible too long.
